newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan cotton rates steady in lackluster trade.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan cotton rates steady in lackluster trade.

text.p: Pakistan's cotton rates ended steady on Tuesday in lackluster trading as textile mill owners, hit by cash shortage, kept to the sidelines, dealers said.
"Mill owners are short of funds and deals are being made on credit," dealer Khushi Ram said. "Lack of demand is likely to slightly ease the cotton prices further in the coming days.
In the kerb market, the NIAB-78 variety was traded at 1,900 rupees ($47.24) per maund (37.32 kg), dealers said.
